title: Barbara Kruger

publisher.name: Gli Ori / Palazzo delle Papesse, Centro Arte Contemporanea

description.main: The catalogue of Barbara Kruger's 2002 exhibition at the Palazzo delle Papesse in Siena, published with Gli Ori, with texts in Italian and English by Angela Vettese, Paolo Fabbri and Marco Pierini.
description.extended:
This is the catalogue of Barbara Kruger's 2002 exhibition at the Palazzo delle Papesse, Centro Arte Contemporanea in Siena, published with Gli Ori.

The show ran from 22 June to 5 September 2002 and brought together about twenty-five works. It gave the first Italian showing of the video installation Power/Pleasure/Desire/Disgust, which Kruger adapted to the Papesse rooms and to an Italian-speaking audience. Outside the building she covered thirteen of Siena's city buses with thirteen slogans in Italian.

The book is a 142-page softcover in red printed wrappers, with several fold-out pages and color and black-and-white illustrations throughout. Angela Vettese, Paolo Fabbri and Marco Pierini contribute the texts, printed in Italian and English, and a bibliography closes the volume.
description.artist_bio: Barbara Kruger (b. 1945, Newark) is an American artist who pairs found photographs with declarative text. She worked as a designer and picture editor at Conde Nast magazines, including Mademoiselle, before turning to photocollage in the late 1970s. She received the Golden Lion for lifetime achievement at the 51st Venice Biennale in 2005.
description.exhibition_context: The Palazzo delle Papesse, Siena's centre for contemporary art, opened its 2002 season with Kruger alongside Studio Azzurro and a bookshop project by Leni Hoffmann.
